summary: Connor Bedard's NHL debut ended in a 4-2 Chicago Blackhawks win over the Pittsburgh Penguins on opening night, with the Blackhawks rallying from a 2-0 deficit. Bedard earned his first NHL point with a secondary assist on Ryan Donato's goal and led Chicago with five shots on goal. The note is a live blog with period-by-period updates, pregame notes, and TV and schedule information.
one_line: Connor Bedard recorded an assist in his NHL debut as the Blackhawks came back from 2-0 down to beat the Penguins 4-2.
key_facts: The Chicago Blackhawks beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 4-2 on opening night, scoring four unanswered goals after trailing 2-0.
Bryan Rust opened the scoring for the Penguins in the first period, and Sidney Crosby made it 2-0 in the second.
Connor Bedard picked up his first NHL point with a secondary assist on Ryan Donato's goal, which came with 4:23 left in the second period.
Cole Guttman tied the game 2-2 with 9:55 left in regulation, on a pass from Seth Jones.
Jason Dickinson scored the go-ahead goal with 4:33 to go, and Nick Foligno added an empty-net goal with 1:27 left.
Bedard had five shots on goal on 11 shot attempts, led the Blackhawks in shots, and played 21:29, second only to Seth Jones.
Bedard won just two of 13 faceoffs.
Pittsburgh finished last season tied for the most losses after taking a lead into the third period, and blew a 2-1 third-period lead again.
The Blackhawks went 0 for 4 on the power play.
Defenseman Kevin Korchinski, the No. 7 pick in the 2022 draft, also made his NHL debut for Chicago.
Erik Karlsson, a three-time Norris Trophy winner, joined the Penguins in a summer trade with the Sharks.
Crosby, Evgeni Malkin and Kris Letang were set to begin an 18th season together, surpassing the Yankees' Jeter, Rivera and Posada as the longest-tenured trio of teammates.
The game was played at PPG Paints Arena in Pittsburgh and aired on ESPN, with Sean McDonough, Ray Ferraro and Emily Kaplan on the call.
Bedard's debut was the most anticipated rookie first game since Auston Matthews in 2016.
